verdict.rationale: Ecosystem vitality is a fair question for an agent framework, so the axis applies. The only related evidence is a pointer to browse templates, which are complete Mastra projects to clone. Nothing shows a community-published catalog of skills, plugins or presets, its scale, or active third-party maintainers. Community comments praise the framework and its team but do not describe a plugin ecosystem.

support.subject: As a power user, the community ecosystem is genuinely alive — thousands of published skills, plugins, or presets with active maintainers
